test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 8 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which ministry launched the ‘Start-up India Seed Fund Scheme?

options.text: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship

solution:
The correct answer is** Ministry of Commerce and Industry.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **DPI **has created** Startup India Seed Fund Scheme (SISFS)** with an outlay of INR 945 Crore to provide financial assistance to startups for proof of Concept.
 
• The** Startup India Seed Fund Scheme** is being implemented by the government with effect from **1 April 2021.**
 
• It provides financial assistance to eligible departments for the** Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade**. 
 
• The Ministry of **International Trade and the Ministry of Industry** were split off from the Ministry of Commerce and Industry in July 1963.
 
• Currently serving as Minister is BJP member** Piyush Goyal.**
 
• Amrit Kaur was a member of **Jawaharlal Nehru's **first cabinet following India's independence. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The head of the Ministry of **Finance for the Government of India is known as the Minister of Finance **or simply the Finance Minister. 

 The finance minister, one of the top positions in the Union Cabinet, is in charge of the nation's budget. 
 
• The Ministry is in charge of organising all** national skill development initiatives**, closing the skills gap between supply and demand, developing the framework for technical and vocational education, skill up-skilling, developing new skills, and encouraging creative thinking that is** not limited to existing jobs. **
 
• **The formation of policies**, planning, development, export promotion, and trade regulation for the textile industry fall within the purview of the** ministry of textiles**. This comprises all cellulosic fibres, both natural and synthetic, used in the production of textiles, apparel, and handicrafts.
